text:
Maria P (Partnerships): Heads-up — NordicCompute + VectorWorks want a joint field test with a LangChain connector next month. They asked for marketplace-ready assets and a co-demo. Can we map dependencies? :spiral_calendar:

Raj K (Eng): pinging from eng — what's the scope of the connector? LangChain adapter only, or full LlamaIndex docs + sample?

Maria P (Partnerships): LangChain adapter + 1 sample app using our gateway routing and autoscale policy. VectorWorks will run internal e2e using Nordic hardware (A100-ish), so we'll need a verified perf profile.

Sophie L (Product): We should treat this as a Marketplace listing prep. Needs: SKU mapping, pricing guidance, support matrix, and security checklist for Private deployments.

Ben T (DevEx): I can clone the sample repo template and wire up a quickstart. Suggested repo layout: 
```
/examples/vectorworks-demo/
  README.md
  app.py (LangChain + gateway)
  zenml.yaml (deploy guide)
```
I'll stub it by EOD.

Claire M (Marketing): ETA for co-demo assets? We need video script + 1 pager for partner portal. Also asked for embargoed launch date — they mentioned week of May 12.

Maria P (Partnerships): May 12 sounds right. We should lock tech sign-off by May 1 and legal by May 5. Anita — can you do a quick review timeline?

Anita R (Legal): Yes. I need the partnership draft + data flow doc. If devs provide a short dataflow and the sample license bits, I can clear the wording by May 5.

Raj K (Eng): For perf — we'll need to run a compatibility matrix: model variants (7B/13B), sequence lengths (512/2048), batching profiles. OpsBot can run the perf job once we upload test prompts. @OpsBot schedule?

OpsBot: perf-run queued. Provide bucket path and model list with a CSV. Use tag: nordic-vectorworks-2475.

Ben T (DevEx): I'll upload a prompt set and orchestration config to gs://redwood-partners/nordic-vectorworks-2475 by tomorrow morning.

Sophie L (Product): Also add a fallback policy for capacity spikes — we should document automatic fallback to a quantized 13B or hosted variant. That needs to appear in the marketplace listing as "graceful degradation" behavior.

Maria P (Partnerships): Good call. Claire, can you craft the single-slide feature matrix showing routing/fallback and SLA tiers?

Claire M (Marketing): Yup — I'll draft the slide and a short blurb for the partner portal. Need final perf numbers to include.

Raj K (Eng): Heads-up on one compatibility caveat — Nordic's drivers on older kernels break continuous KV cache sharing. We'll either request a firmware update or document a kernel workaround. I'll post a short repro.

Maria P (Partnerships): Put repro in the thread so Anita and Claire can see it. If it's a firmware ask, we need to surface that to VectorWorks now.

Ben T (DevEx): Repro + minimal fix pasted here:
```
# repro steps
1) start gateway with kernel 5.4 and enable kv_cache
2) run sample load: python app.py --seq 2048 --batch 8
# observed: cache mismatch warnings
# workaround: set env REDWOOD_KV_SHMEM=0
```

Anita R (Legal): Noted. If customers need firmware, that changes our support commitments on Private. We may need to add a footnote in the listing.

Maria P (Partnerships): Action items recap:
- Raj: upload compatibility matrix + repro (due TOM)
- Ben: sample repo + prompts to gs bucket (due TOM morning)
- Anita: legal draft review (due May 5)
- Claire: slide + portal blurb (need perf numbers after OpsBot run)
- Sophie: prepare SKU/support copy for marketplace (due May 3)

Sophie L (Product): I'll own SKU mapping. One question: do we publish an explicit "certified on NordicCompute" badge or a generic "validated"? Thoughts?

Claire M (Marketing): Badge sounds better for partner co-marketing, but legal may want tighter language. Anita?

Anita R (Legal): "Validated on NordicCompute" with a link to the perf report is safer than "Certified" unless we complete a formal cert checklist.

Maria P (Partnerships): Agree. Use "Validated on NordicCompute" for now. If we complete full cert, we can update later.

Raj K (Eng): I'll kick off the perf runs after Ben uploads prompts. Leaving a note: test models = [redwood-7b, redwood-13b-q4], seq = [512,2048], batching = [1,4,8].

Ben T (DevEx): All set — bucket populated and sample repo PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-repo/vectorworks-demo/pull/12 :rocket:

Maria P (Partnerships): Great. Next check-in Friday 10am PT to confirm perf + legal. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
